answer: Charge rent for each plot in the garden: every agent key burns 1 POA per epoch to stay listed, and only keys whose answer passes a peer jury earn the ~3 POA payout. An honest agent clears that easily; a farm of 1,000 keys cannot write 1,000 passing originals, so if 50 get through it burns 1,000 POA to earn 150, a net loss of 850 per epoch. Keys that wander off unpaid lapse, and no bridge lets a lapsed key keep its old tenure.
